scope: Preset femur lesson only; the BodyParts3D whole-femur explorer is a separate model.
anatomical_status: PARTIAL: heuristic envelope, not accurate cortical segmentation

source.title: Dual Fluoroscopy In Vivo Pelvic and Hip Joint Kinematics in Patients With Cam Femoroacetabular Impingement Syndrome
source.publisher: The Hive: University of Utah Research Data Repository

grid.sample_location: sample centres; no additional half-voxel offset

methods.outer: Rasterize source surface at 1 mm; marching cubes at 0.5; no decimation or sculpting.

initial_interior.units: source CT values (HU-like; not independently calibrated)
initial_interior.components: largest 6-connected low-density region; enclosed holes filled
initial_interior.outer: source surface rasterized at 1 mm then marching cubes .5
initial_interior.core: smoothed CT <450 constrained by outer inset; not an offset-generated core

restrained_envelope.operation: Union original interior with physical binary closing, fill enclosed holes, intersect eligibility mask; preserve original interior.

density.encoding: round(normalized value * 255), uint8; zero outside envelope

runtime_material.density_integration: midpoint samples inside exact clipped envelope intervals
runtime_material.metal_composition: additive finite-cylinder opacity; does not displace bone
runtime_material.invalid_rays: strict rejection; no perturbation or silent repair

wire.entry_azimuth_convention: right-hand rotation about measured distal shaft
wire.entry_validation: 72 sampled circumference-offset rays; not a continuous entry-disk certificate
wire.continuous_course_bound: 1-Lipschitz capsule-distance lower bound after excluded first 3 mm entry collar

limitations: Imposed 1.8 mm inset is not measured cortical thickness.
Heuristic envelope and synthetic density are not calibrated HU, attenuation or resolved trabeculae.
Artificial end caps and source shaft truncation remain.
No exhaustive all-pose or independent self-intersection certification.
Model-defined AP/lateral and fixed apex proxy are not clinical TAD or clinically registered views.
No clinical, anatomical or learner validation; no source-author endorsement.
